summary: Investigated why extension tabs were missing in the Gizmo app: the global resources.json at C:\Users\mchan\.gizmo\resources.json had disabledGizmoExtensions set to [unity, svelte, skill-authoring], which filtered out those domains from activeDomains. Re-enabled the disabled extensions via the agent-server WebSocket (resources.gizmo-extension.global) and verified resources.json now has an empty disabledGizmoExtensions list and projects report activity/git/svelte/unity integrations.
decisions: Identified the root cause as globally disabled Gizmo extensions in ~/.gizmo/resources.json suppressing activeDomains, not a bundle-loading failure
Re-enabled all three disabled extensions (unity, svelte, skill-authoring) via the running agent-server's resources.gizmo-extension.global request rather than editing resources.json directly
Concluded a full app restart (not just workspace switch) is required because browser extension bundles load at startup and activeDomains did not refresh in the running client
errors: Read of C:\Users\mchan\.gizmo\resource-settings.json failed with ENOENT; the correct file name was resources.json, found by inspecting global-resource-settings.ts
